How to read: Each topic's estimated score = sum of KPI scores (traffic-light basis) + uplift bonus earned. Basic Score and Uplift use traffic-light status at the time of viewing. This is not an official performance rating.
Grand Total calculates the score using the combined totals of all EAs, so larger portfolios have a bigger impact on the result.
Region/MU Average calculates each EA's score separately, then averages them, giving every EA equal weight regardless of size.

Baseline for Achieving
1. Success Plan enablement completed by the EA.

Uplift for Exceeding

• At least one net-new Success Plan contract signed for the assigned customers or opportunity in phase A/B.
• For relevant assigned customers, PE or PrS successfully converted into a Success Plan.
• Success Plans used to replace shelfware or churn-risk products.
